text:
You know how Old Man Miller lives in that super tall, white lighthouse on the cliff? The one that looks like a giant toothpaste tube? Well, guess what happened this morning! I was sitting by the window eating my toast, and it was *so* foggy outside. Like, seriously thick. You couldn’t even see your own hand if you waved it in front of your face! It was like being inside a big, gray cloud monster.

Anyway, Mr. Miller usually just polishes his glasses and reads his newspaper when it’s like that. But he wasn’t doing that. He was standing right at the edge of the balcony, leaning way out over the railing. He had his big brass telescope pressed tight against his eye, and he was making these weird noises. Not talking, but kind of… humming? And then he’d go, "Huh?" or "Oh my gosh!" really quietly.

I tried to see what he saw, but I’m too short, so I could only see the bottom of his coat tails flapping in the wind. Suddenly, he jumped back inside and slammed the door shut! Then, ten seconds later, he opened it again and peeked out, looking super nervous. He grabbed his radio mic and started shouting into it, but I couldn’t hear what he said because the fog is so loud—it makes everything sound muffled, like talking underwater.

He looked scared, buddy. Really scared. Do you think he saw a ghost ship? Or maybe a sea monster that eats fog? I bet it’s something huge. We have to go ask him after school!
